verdict.rationale: Veo has a first-party developer API surface: the Gemini API video docs describe turning text prompts into videos and refining them via the Interactions API, and community reports use the model ID veo-2.0-generate-001. That covers only the submit step of the loop. Agent-readable docs are thin: the ai.google.dev llms.txt and all OpenAPI paths return 404, and the only llms.txt found (deepmind.google) covers prompt formatting, not API mechanics. The one cost mention is a user's after-the-fact GCP bill, not cost reporting by the product. Missing for 10: documented job status polling, an asset download/retrieval step, per-job cost reporting via the API, and a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or llms.txt) an agent could use on its own.
